beats.text: Croatia has 7 years of preschool. In Tanzania, it is 1 year.
Preprimary duration refers to the number of grades in preprimary school.
Croatia: 7 years. El Salvador: 7 years. Estonia: 7 years. Guatemala: 7 years.
India and China both provide 3 years of preschool for young children.
Tanzania: 1 year. Croatia gives 7 times the preschool Tanzania gives.
How many years of preschool does your country offer to children?
